heading: Specialized Orthodontic Care for Every Smile
subheading: From early intervention to complex craniofacial treatment, we tailor every plan to your unique needs.

items.name: Cleft Lip and Palate Treatment
items.desc: Comprehensive orthodontic support that helps patients with cleft conditions achieve functional, confident smiles.

items.name: Craniofacial Orthodontics
items.desc: Specialized care for complex facial and skeletal conditions, improving both appearance and long-term oral function.

items.name: Damon Smile
items.desc: Self-ligating braces that move teeth more comfortably and efficiently with fewer adjustments and shorter treatment time.

items.name: Dentofacial Orthopedics
items.desc: Guides jaw and facial bone development to correct bite problems and create lasting structural harmony.

items.name: Digital X-rays
items.desc: Low-radiation digital imaging delivers precise diagnostics while keeping your exposure and wait time to a minimum.

items.name: Early Orthodontic Treatment
items.desc: Intercepting bite and alignment issues in young children prevents more complex and costly treatment later on.

items.name: Emergency Care
items.desc: Prompt attention for broken brackets, loose wires, or discomfort so your treatment stays on track.

items.name: In-Ovation Braces
items.desc: Low-profile self-ligating brackets reduce friction and discomfort, helping you reach your smile goal faster.
